annotations.title: Find the ETFIQ page that answers a question

description: The designed ETFIQ pages that answer a question, best first, at most three (fund, comparison, holders of a company, ranking, theme, category, issuer, flows, screen, benchmark, FAQ, methodology). Each has title, address, dated lead sentence, numbers from its .json twin, match score (0 to 100) and reason. answered is false when none matches. Deterministic matching. Pass path instead of query to read one page's card.

path.description: Optional, instead of query: one ETFIQ address, such as /holdings/nvda/, for that page's card.

query.description: The reader's question, in their words.

name: find_page

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
